label: acetylated residue
description: A protein modification that effectively replaces one or more hydrogen atoms with one or more acetyl groups.

label: methylated residue
description: From DeltaMass: Average Mass: 14 Average Mass Change:14 References:Methylation of Asparagine (found in phycobiliproteins) Klotz and Glazer (1987) J. Biol. Chem. 262; 17350-17355

label: glycosylated residue
description: A protein modification that effectively replaces a hydrogen atom with an carbohydrate-like group through a glycosidic bond.

label: N-glycosylated residue
description: A protein modification that effectively replaces a residue hydrogen atom on a nitrogen with a carbohydrate-like group through a glycosidic bond.

label: O-glycosylated residue
description: A protein modification that effectively replaces a residue hydrogen atom on an oxygen with a carbohydrate-like group through a glycosidic bond.

label: phosphorylated L-histidine
description: A protein modification that effectively converts an L-histidine residue to a phosphorylated L-histidine, such as pros-phosphohistidine, or tele-phosphohistidine.

label: O-phosphorylated residue
description: A protein modification that effectively replaces a residue hydroxyl or carboxyl hydrogen with a phosphono group (H2PO3 or 'phosphate').

label: N-phosphorylated residue
description: A protein modification that effectively replaces a hydrogen atom of a residue amino or imino group with a phosphono group (H2PO3 or 'phosphate').

label: monomethylated L-lysine
description: A protein modification that effectively replaces one hydrogen atom of an L-lysine residue with one methyl group.

label: N6-acetyl-L-lysine
description: A protein modification that effectively converts an L-lysine residue to N6-acetyl-L-lysine.

label: oxidized residue
description: A protein modification that effectively either removes neutral hydrogen atoms (proton and electron), or adds oxygen atoms to a residue with or without the removal of hydrogen atoms.

label: nitrosylated residue
description: A protein modification that effectively replaces a hydrogen atom with an nitrosyl (NO) group.

label: protein modification
description: Covalent modification of, or a change resulting in an alteration of the measured molecular mass of, a peptide or protein amino acid residue.
